Alex / Mina — thanks, quick read-through and a few high-level markers before our formal mark-up:

- IP Exhibit: Redwood’s standard position is as Mina described — customers get a limited license to outputs for internal use. AltArc’s ask re: ownership of derivatives would be a material change; please let us know the business rationale if you need that.
- Data retention / logging: If AltArc requires deletion or specific retention windows, note them now; we may need product support for enforced TTLs.
- Limitation of Liability / Cap: we'll propose standard cap tied to fees paid in prior 12 months; if AltArc requests higher caps, provide insurance evidence.
- Subprocessing / hosting: please confirm whether AltArc will require on-prem or VPC deployment — that affects the security addendum.

I’ll upload a redline (redlines_marked.docx) with comments for the key sections (IP exhibit, liability, termination, confidentiality). Aim to have that to you by EOD Tue 11 Aug.

If AltArc can confirm the signer and billing contact in the next 24 hours that will help shorten turnaround.
